# Mini Season: Night at the Morgue Challenges and Guides

The Night at the Morgue Mini Season is a limited-time event in Fallout 76.

Running from **October 21, 2025** to **November 4, 2025**, ending at **12 PM US EST** (Atom Shop changeover).

There is no specific item to claim. Instead, players are required to equip a costume.

To check if an item counts as a costume, open it in Inspect mode via your Pip-Boy. The item description will indicate whether it qualifies as a costume.

To participate, equip a costume and complete the listed challenges to earn exclusive, limited-time rewards.

**How it works:**

Complete each challenge to earn tickets, which can then be used to purchase the rewards of your choice from the limited-time reward board. This system works similarly to the current Season structure.

__FAQ__

**Can we re-roll the challenges?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a custom server?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a private server, by myself, if I create a public team?**

Yes.

**Can I complete these challenges in one day?**

Yes. All the weekly challenges unlock on the first day, so you can complete them anytime throughout the week, except for the daily ones, which only appear each day.

**Can I wear Power Armor while completing these challenges?**

**Yes!** — The challenge has been updated so that as long as you have the item equipped, it will count. This means you can now complete the challenge without exiting Power Armor or removing your helmet.

**Can I still get intoxicated if I am a Ghoul?**

Yes, you can.

**Can I complete the challenges on different characters?**

Yes. As long as you are on the same account and the character has the required item equipped, you can spread the challenges across multiple characters.

**Why can’t I unlock the rewards when I have enough tickets?**

You need to claim and unlock rewards in a specific order; you can’t just pick and choose which ones to claim. If you hover over a reward, it will show you which items you need to claim first before it becomes available.
